import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between sepal and petal measurements
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', palette='Set1', markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Add a title
plt.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Classification', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
